# BB00600 {.unnumbered}

In the name of God the exalting, master of those who exalt through God

God the exalting, master of the exalting. Say: Praise be God! Verily You exalt the heavens and the earth and whatsoever lies between them, then all those who exalt. Say: Praise be God! Verily You ordain the heavens and the earth and whatsoever lies between them, then all those who ordain. Say: Praise be God! Verily You help the heavens and the earth and what lies between them, then all those who help. Say: Praise be God! Verily You conquer the heavens and the earth and whatsoever is between them. You create what You will by your command. Verily You are the greatest of those who ordain.
